review: Fix the required interface IDs everywhere: entities keys and Entity.id must be hero (Bea), helper (Mr Ivo), grandpa (Grandpa Len), tool (shaping rib). Keep human names only in Entity.noun. Holder locations, w.hero/helper/tool, all frame actor IDs and all references must use these IDs. The initial source contract required this.

After inspecting and choosing a design, cup.state itself must contain wall_checked (not only a world flag). dry must require it and fail if an intervention removes it. Keep the prior inspection requirement. Do not weaken checks.

Before committing give require fired/safe_edges/stable/wide_handle and both people present; use requires fired and cup held by grandpa; ending checks tool at helper, sponge at bench, cup held by grandpa and tea. These are later checks not reached in the first attempt due to dry failure.

Attention feature matching is currently broken. score_frame extracts feature = fact.id.split(".")[-1] and coefficients.get(feature,0). Use hero.Care and hero.Fear fact IDs with matching Care/Fear preference names, and query tags that match. thumb should become more probable with higher Care, both designs still valid. Expose mutable memes to the actual score.

The long sequence of bare cup transport/firing sentences reads like a process log. Keep all necessary physical events and safe cooling, but add a few joined typed clauses that express Bea's goal, uncertainty, and design consequence, and several semantic-equivalent g.either alternatives. Do not invent effects, skip physical steps, or exceed 24 events. Clarify why a wide handle helps stiff hands.

Avoid dangling pronouns across locally changed subjects and repeating the same indefinite within one sentence; use explicit proper ref for changed person and grounded definite NPs for repeated local objects. Keep the final image tied to the chosen design.
